params.body:
## What changes

The context panel had two ways of saving: each property (Groep, Belang, Draagt, the colleagues) was saved on tap, and the context had its own "Context bewaren" button inside the left column. It was unclear what was kept and when.

- **One Bewaren, under both columns.** Tapping a property only changes the panel. Bewaren keeps the note and the properties together. Until then the footer says "Nog niet bewaard"; after, "Bewaard om HH:MM".
- **What moves on.** Bewaren with a note, or Niets bijzonders, marks the item as discussed and the list opens the next one, as before. Bewaren with only properties changed keeps them and leaves the item open.
- **Niets bijzonders** keeps the properties tapped before it.
- Bewaren with nothing written and nothing changed still asks for text.

## Tests

- Properties are not stored before Bewaren; after it they are, with `tag-saved` and no `context-saved`.
- A note and the property tapped with it are kept by the same save.
- Niets bijzonders keeps the tapped properties.
- 337 pass; pint clean. Checked in the browser: Midden, Iemand anders and a note saved with one click, and the list moved to the next relation.
